The verified record shows no system context is supplied at all, so the load-bearing traffic-splittable premise is asserted, not established; if false the whole recommendation collapses to blue-green/ring instead.

The claim that automated SLO-gated promotion preserves delivery speed depends on health signals existing and settling within cadence, yet no telemetry or SLO evidence is grounded (ev_initial_entry_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa_2 and _4 are engine_unverified) and the verified evidence confirms no metrics are provided. If signals are noisy or slow, gating either stalls promotion (harming speed, issue:2) or passes bad releases (harming risk, issue:1), so the 'optimizes both' claim is unproven.
